questions.text: Namaste! Main UC ki screening assistant hoon. Ye baat-cheet sirf screening ke liye record hogi. Shuru karein? Aap Hindi mein baat karengi ya English mein?
questions.rule: No consent -> manual screening, not an automatic rejection.

questions.text: Aap Bangalore mein kis area mein rehti hain? Roz aas-paas kin areas mein aana-jaana hota hai?
questions.probe: Agar kaam thoda door ke area mein mile, ya paas shift hona pade, to aapko kaisa lagega?
questions.rule: Area requires manual proximity check. Far and unwilling to move -> reject according to workbook.

questions.text: Aadhaar card pe aapki date of birth kya likhi hai?
questions.rule: Age <= 38: pass; age 39-40: manual review; age > 40 or < 18: reject according to workbook.

questions.text: Apne ghar ke baare mein thoda bataiye — ghar mein kaun kaun hai, aur din bhar kaun kya karta hai?
Bachche kis class mein padhte hain?
questions.probe: Sabse chhota bachcha kitne saal ka hai?
questions.rule: Youngest child under 3 years -> defer according to workbook.

questions.text: Jab aap kaam pe hoti hain, tab bachchon ka din kaise chalta hai — school ke baad unke saath kaun hota hai?
questions.probe: Jab pehle aap kaam karti thi, tab bhi wahi sambhalte the?
questions.rule: Workbook requires a named family-member caregiver; unresolved cases need review.

questions.text: Aane wale ek saal mein ghar mein koi badi cheez plan hai — jaise shaadi, family badhana, ya shift hona?
questions.probe: Agar abhi aap expecting hain to bata dijiye — training aur kaam physically heavy hote hain, isliye poochna zaroori hai.
questions.rule: Workbook specifies defer for pregnancy or a baby plan within 6 months; a plan within 6-12 months is flagged. Preserve privacy and review requirements.

questions.text: Abhi aapka kaam kaise chal raha hai — kisi salon mein hain, ya ghar pe bhi clients aate hain?
questions.probe: UC join karne ke baad un clients ka kya karengi?
questions.rule: If salon is closed, manual proof check. Workbook flags continuing own-salon/client work as a rejection condition.

questions.text: Pichli jagah aap sabse zyada kaun si services karti thi? Pedicure-manicure kitni baar karti thi?
questions.probe: Agar pedicure kam kiya hai, to seekhne mein kaisa lagega?
questions.rule: Pedicure refusal without willingness to learn is a rejection condition. Bikini-wax response is noted only.

questions.text: Abhi aap kaam pe ya market kaise jaati hain?
questions.probe: Agar job 3–4 km door ho to kaise pahunchengi — scooty se khud, ya koi chhodega?
questions.rule: Refusal to travel or learn two-wheeler use is a rejection condition; dependence on husband for travel is flagged.

questions.text: (Tablet shows card) Ye address aur service card zor se padhiye.
questions.rule: Record fluent, with mistakes, or unable; unable to read English words triggers the workbook's rejection rule.

questions.text: Maan lijiye aap customer ke ghar pahunchi hain. Mujhe customer samajhkar Hindi ya English mein apna introduction dijiye.
questions.probe: Ab batayiye aap aaj kya service karengi.
questions.rule: Cannot converse in Hindi or English triggers the workbook's rejection rule; also contributes to communication scoring.

questions.text: Kya kabhi pehle UC, Yes Madam ya kisi aur app ke through kaam kiya hai? Unme kaun se phone number use kiye the?
questions.probe: Koi purana number ya doosra sim? Kaunsi category mein thi?
questions.rule: All numbers and relevant details go to a manual profile check.
